directive.quote: New home: a new tool in this repo (trillion-workshop) at tools/<plain-job-name>/. Reuse the SSH helper (administrationArguments) instead of copying it.

old_copy.deleted_with: the same Trillion-X/trillion pull request: scripts/portable-service-connection.mjs imports administrationArguments from the trillion-workshop package instead of keeping its own

preserve: the host is checked before any argument is made
a missing administration key is refused with the same words
only the given key file (IdentitiesOnly), batch mode, strict host key checking against the given known_hosts file, and a 10 second connect timeout
allowed_deltas: the user and port are the caller's admin_user and ssh_port instead of root and 22
the address may be a DNS name as well as IPv4
no agent (IdentityAgent=none) and no global known_hosts
checkedHost and knownHostsLine pin the host from a host_key the caller gives

c.proxy, when given, starts the arguments with proxied(c.proxy): the ssh ProxyCommand through a run's loopback CONNECT proxy and a 30 second keepalive, moved here from tools/keep-a-door-tunnel-open (which took it from renew-a-tls-certificate) so there is one administrationArguments
heldKeyFile gives a mounted key file back the newline the vault drops, for every caller that hands ssh a held key
banned_substitutions: a user, port or host written into the code
